narrative.overview: This is the production-source continuation of the approved MealForm administration and weekly viewer previews in Operate mode. The inherited world uses clear week hierarchy, grouped tools, flat surfaces and Vietnamese labels to help school staff work through menus and registrations. No new visual metaphor or imagery system is introduced.
keyCharacteristics: Actual current, next and archived weeks remain distinct.
Runtime school branding supplies semantic light/dark colors.
Self-hosted Vietnamese typography, visible focus and touch-sized primary controls.
Complete response fields and the original permission and confirmation flows.

rules.name: The Runtime Branding Rule
rules.body: Bind interface colors to the existing semantic runtime variables, including default-brand light mode and portaled surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and borders for ordinary content; reserve temporary-layer depth for the existing popovers and dialogs.

dos: Do keep runtime branding, Vietnamese labels, visible focus and touch-sized primary controls.
Do preserve week identity, complete response fields and existing role, confirmation and verified-read guards.
Do update the canonical token JSON and compile generated CSS through the shared compiler.
Do verify both surfaces at desktop, intermediate and mobile widths, including large text and dark mode.
donts: Don't promote sampled preview colors into production defaults or introduce a new visual world.
Don't duplicate preference state, shorten response fields or bypass existing callbacks and permission gates.
Don't claim an imported official Figma kit, automatic two-way token sync, pixel-perfect Figma parity or a cloud Chromatic baseline.
Don't treat local visual approval as user staging approval or evidence that production has been merged or promoted.
